description: Regions are alpha-trimmed per frame after row/column gutters are detected from the source-wide alpha>128 projection. Feet use shoe contacts in the bottom eight primary-alpha rows; head uses the central upper silhouette. Weak-alpha anti-alias fringes receive a 2px pad. Optional source_scale is a finite 0.01–4 per-frame multiplier on the shared actor/reference scale, never a per-frame bounds fit. The traveller jump action retains a shared atlas-row baseline so its authored airborne height is preserved. No frame is mirrored, copied, or synthetically padded.

traveller.station_stand: idle/front/frame_0 (same authored frame; not a separate animation)

coverage_notes.traveller: Front actions with dedicated authored idle in all eight directions. Existing eight-direction walk remains in the legacy atlas. Jump is an eight-pose front action at 12 FPS; other jump directions are not authored here. Seated and catch actions retain separately authored metadata.
coverage_notes.traveller_outfit_coral: Historical incomplete vest candidate only: retained for provenance, never selected. The shipping coral jacket is a palette of the complete base body in every action and direction.
coverage_notes.ticket: Walk row is only a walk_candidate pending authored validation.
coverage_notes.announcer: Side-walk adds four authored profile poses each for right and left from the first four cells per atlas row. Four repeated cells per row are excluded; diagonal and front/back walk directions remain uncovered.
